This is the exact complete portable runtime from main at `3af48ea0900fe7f597e3fdeb6d2b525acf984bf8`, before `am` was introduced. It is generated with `git archive` and its checksum and artifact digest are recorded in provenance.json. Migration tests execute its actual installer and updater, rather than constructing an old-looking receipt consumed by new code. Keeping this bounded immutable fixture lets source archives run the regression without fetching Git history or depending on network access. Tests extract only regular files/directories into disposable homes.
